C0537.title: Woman Detained for 70+ Malicious 'Refund-Only' Claims Exceeding ¥20,000
C0537.summary: A woman was criminally detained for using multiple accounts to fraudulently request refund-only claims over 70 times, with the total amount exceeding ¥20,000.

references.title: Malicious 'refund-only' applications over 70 times, total exceeding 20,000 yuan, woman involved detained
